description: Expand System Settings and Admin Profile pages with comprehensive configuration sections, security preferences, notification settings, backup/restore UI (frontend only), profile management, password change, and activity history. Add missing profile and settings routes to AdminApp.jsx
steps: Add missing profile route to src/AdminApp.jsx: Import AdminProfilePage and add route path='profile' element={<AdminProfilePage />} inside the admin layout routes

Expand SystemSettingsPage in src/pages/Admin/Settings/SystemSettingsPage.jsx (already has good structure): Add Platform Configuration section (platform name, description, contact email, support URL - all editable). Add Email Configuration section (SMTP settings, email templates selection, test email button - UI only). Add Backup & Maintenance section (last backup date, backup frequency dropdown, backup now button, restore from backup button, maintenance mode toggle - all UI only with localStorage). Add Reports Configuration section (default assignment timeout, auto-escalation rules, priority calculation rules - dropdowns and inputs). Add Integrations section (placeholder for future API integrations, webhook configuration). Make all sections save to localStorage with proper validation

Expand AdminProfilePage in src/pages/Admin/Profile/AdminProfilePage.jsx (already has good structure): Add Security section with: change password form (current password, new password, confirm password - validation only, no actual change), two-factor authentication toggle (UI only), active sessions list (mock 2-3 sessions with device, location, last active, revoke button), login history table (last 10 logins with timestamp, IP, device, status). Add Preferences section: language selection (English, Amharic), timezone selection, date format, email notification preferences (report updates, user actions, system alerts). Add Activity section: recent actions by this admin (last 20 from audit log filtered by actor)
Add mockAdminSessions in src/data/mockAdminData.js: Array of 2-3 active sessions with device, browser, location, ip, lastActive
Add mockAdminLoginHistory in src/data/mockAdminData.js: Array of 15 login attempts with timestamp, ip, device, browser, location, status (success/failed)
Create PasswordChangeModal component in src/pages/Admin/Profile/PasswordChangeModal.jsx: Modal with password change form, strength indicator, validation messages
Create SessionsTable component in src/pages/Admin/Profile/SessionsTable.jsx: Table showing active sessions with revoke capability
Update mockAdminData.js: Add adminPreferences object with language, timezone, dateFormat, emailNotificationPreferences
acceptance_criteria: AdminApp.jsx includes profile route and navigates correctly when clicking Profile in top bar dropdown
SystemSettingsPage displays all new configuration sections (Platform, Email, Backup, Reports, Integrations)
All settings sections save to localStorage and persist across page reloads
Settings validation prevents saving invalid configurations (e.g., empty required fields)
AdminProfilePage displays Security section with password change form
Password change modal validates password strength and shows appropriate messages
Active sessions table displays mock sessions with working revoke button (removes from UI)
Login history table shows last 15 logins with all details
Preferences section allows changing language, timezone, date format, and saves to localStorage
Activity section shows recent actions from audit log filtered by current admin
All forms and modals have proper validation and error messages
verification: Run npm run dev and navigate to /admin
Click Profile in top bar dropdown - should navigate to /admin/profile
Verify all profile sections render: Security, Preferences, Activity
Click Change Password - modal should open with validation
Enter passwords - strength indicator should update
Verify active sessions table shows mock sessions
Click revoke on a session - should remove from UI
Verify login history table shows 15 entries
Change preferences (language, timezone) and save - should persist after refresh
Verify all configuration sections render correctly
Edit platform configuration and save - should persist to localStorage
Toggle maintenance mode - should save state
Test email configuration button - should show feedback message
Verify no console errors on either page
